title: Exercise 3 – Lending and borrowing
text: A risky fund has an expected return of 12% and a volatility of 20%. You can lend and borrow at the risk-free rate of 3%.

title: Exercise 4 – Kappa AG
text: The risk-free rate is 3%, the expected market return 9% and the market volatility 18%. Kappa AG has a volatility of 30% and a correlation of 0.6 with the market. An analyst expects Kappa to return 11% next year.

title: Exercise 5 – Orion SA
text: Orion SA has equity with a market value of EUR 600m and debt of EUR 400m. Its cost of equity is 11% and its cost of debt 5%. The corporate tax rate is 25%.

title: Exercise 6 – Café Atlas
text: An entrepreneur invests EUR 400 today in a project that pays EUR 780 next year if the economy is strong and EUR 520 if it is weak, each with probability 0.5. The unlevered cost of capital is 30% and the risk-free rate 4%. She borrows EUR 300 at the risk-free rate and raises the rest with equity. Perfect capital markets.
